abilities.name: ORBITAL DROP
abilities.description: A drop pod slams down, stunning enemies. Two Space Marines hold the position for 25 seconds.

abilities.name: ORBITAL BOMBARDMENT
abilities.description: The battle barge fires its lance batteries: after 2 seconds the target area is obliterated.

abilities.name: AERIAL SUPPORT
abilities.description: A Thunderhawk gunship strafes across the battlefield and carpet-bombs the target area.
